page.layout: One printed page: woodcut ornament and title block at full width at the top; then running text in one column below, with a historiated initial at its start. Stamp at top right is a library stamp (not transcribed). Faint show-through text in the margins is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Illustri & Generoso Domino, DN. WLADISLAO COMITI AB OSTROROG, POLONO, DOMINO IN Krilhovv, &c. Illustris & Magnifici viri ac Domini, DN. NICOLAI COMITIS AB OSTROROG, DOMINI IN KRILHOW, &c. Castellani Belzensis, Sonceliensis Capitanei in Poloniâ, filio & heredi vnico, Domino meo gratiosissimo S. D.
main_text.p: ILLVSTRIS & Generose DomineComes Wladislae, Quales hoc seculum, alias illuminatû Dei gratiâ si vlterius aliud vel maiorû gentium, magnâ copiâ

page.notes: The initial "I" is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as I. Line "Illustris & Generosae" is set in small capitals in the scan; the line ending "(?)" and the lower-left word "vlterius" are doubtful. Some words at the left edge of the text block are partly obscured by damage and marked as read.
